purpose: Post-exploration teaching extension; not a fresh blind benchmark or reproduction of the original tables
budget: For N=300 represented training images, include shared mean D=196: CSA=N*r*r+28*r+D; PCA=(N+D)*d+D. Choose largest integer d with PCA storage <= CSA storage. Do not extrapolate to one new image or bytes on disk.
selection: All grid points reported, no test-based winner selection. Gallery uses first native test ID of each digit within the fixed test subset. Reuses previously explored test set.
